title: Kim Scott's Labor Day 2026 reading list — Incorruptible alongside Multipliers, Larry Page & Sergey Brin's Google S-1, and Cory Doctorow
summary: Kim Scott (co-founder of Radical Candor, NYT bestselling author) publishes a Labor Day essay on the books that make the case for treating employees well — placing Incorruptible in a canon with Liz Wiseman's Multipliers, Tiffani Bova's The Experience Mindset, Larry Page and Sergey Brin's Google S-1 letter, Claire Stapleton's Don't Be Evil, and Cory Doctorow's Chokepoint Capitalism, Enshittification, and The Reverse Centaur's Guide to Life After AI. Her fourth distinct Incorruptible recommendation of 2026.
blockquote: Eric Ries's book Incorruptible, which explains why shareholder primacy hurts employees–and ultimately shareholders.
attribution_title: Co-founder, Radical Candor · NYT Bestselling Author: Radical Candor & Radical Respect
